title: KNBS county crop production (Area + Production), Kenya
citation: KNBS 2024. National Agriculture Production Report: 2023-2024. Nairobi, Kenya.
license: KNBS — public official statistics; cite KNBS.
method: Dual-engine deterministic extraction (_sources/parse_napr.py) per METHODOLOGY_extraction_QA.md. Two independent position/character engines — pdfplumber extract_tables + PyMuPDF get_text word-clustering — extract each county annex; values parsed by explicit code (comma-strip), never read by an LLM. A crop is served only if the two engines AGREE cell-by-cell AND the county sum reconciles to the annex's printed national Total (additivity).
validation: 10 crops served. Dual-engine cell agreement 99–100% per crop (maize Top-20 table 190/190=100%). Additivity 100.0% for the 9 full-annex crops (county sum = printed Total, every year); maize is the report's Top-producing-counties table (19 counties) — validated cell-by-cell dual-engine, but not additivity-complete (top counties only, ~all meaningful maize).
grain: one row per crop × county × year

columns.crop: crop (Sorghum, Finger millet, Pearl millet, Dry beans, Cowpeas, Green grams, Pigeon peas, Irish potato, Sweet potato)
columns.pdf_page: annex page (a human can open it)
columns.dual_ok: passed the dual-engine agreement + additivity gates

coverage: 10 crops, 2019–2023. 9 full-county food crops (producing counties per crop) + maize (19 top-producing counties from the clean Top-20 table).
known_gaps: MAIZE served from the clean Top-20 table (19 counties), NOT the full Annex 1 (pp.114–115), which is mirror-reversed AND transposed — neither additivity (order-invariant) nor dual-engine (both engines read the mirroring identically) can validate it per-county. The ~28 non-top counties grow negligible maize.
COFFEE (Annex 11) is mirror-reversed with no clean in-body county table — cannot be validated; deferred.
COTTON county production is fragmented across text-contaminated in-body tables + a mirrored lint annex (Annex 14) — no single clean table; deferred.
Livestock-population annexes (cattle/sheep/goats/camels by county) available in the same report — not yet extracted.
used_by: notebook.qmd Key Facts — 'What does my county produce?' (Table / Bars / Treemap / Lineplot views)
